diarization._model_replacement_comment: Change backend/model to replace diarization model. Examples: pyannote + pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1, sortformer + nvidia/diar_sortformer_4spk-v1, diarizen + BUT-FIT/diarizen-wavlm-large-s80-md.

asr._model_replacement_comment: Change model to replace ASR model. Keep backend=phowhisper_local for local PhoWhisper-compatible Transformers models.

state_labeling._model_replacement_comment: Change model to replace the Qwen/OpenAI-compatible state-labeling model.

music_separation._model_replacement_comment: Change model to replace Demucs music separation model, for example htdemucs or another model supported by demucs.pretrained.get_model.

overlap_separation._model_replacement_comment: Change backend/model_name to replace overlap speech separation model. Examples: clearvoice + alibabasglab/MossFormer2_SS_16K, speechbrain + speechbrain/sepformer-wsj02mix, sepreformer + SepReformer_Base_WSJ0. pyannote PixIT is tracked here as the pyannote speech-separation model profile; the current runtime still exposes its diarization labels through diarization.backend=pixit for backward compatibility.

_model_replacement_examples.runtime_note: Separation model profile. Use diarization.backend=pixit only when you need the legacy pyannote PixIT diarization-label wrapper.
